message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on Johnson Health Tech tablet consoles for exercise equipment. I recall the tablets being classified as parts of exercise equipment in 9506.91.0030, though I am working from memory and have not checked the ruling.

The alternative is heading 8471, as an automatic data processing machine. Note 5 to Chapter 84 describes ADP machines, and Section XVI Note 2(b) says parts that suit a particular machine go with that machine. Because the consoles are designed to be incorporated into exercise equipment and control it, they are parts of that equipment. Items that are only to be built in and cannot work independently usually fall under 9506.91 as parts and accessories.

The description says the units are "fully functioning tablets" that also run apps. CBP has previously ruled on similar consoles with Android, and I recall some of those going to 8471.30. Here, though, the description stresses that the consoles are "specifically designed for incorporation into exercise equipment" and "used to control and operate the specific exercise equipment." I therefore settle on 9506.91.0030, which covers articles and equipment for general physical exercise, parts and accessories.

{"hts_code": "9506.91.0030", "reason": "The tablet consoles are dedicated to being permanently installed in and controlling exercise equipment, so they are classified as parts and accessories of exercise equipment under heading 9506.91."}
